verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships a browser Playground where users can just type natural-language prompts with no key/install needed, and the API supports tool-calling/function-calling that lets natural-language instructions trigger agent actions — both point toward NL-driven use. However, there is no evidence that the product itself (account, endpoint, billing management) can be operated via natural-language commands; the console/dashboard and dedicated-endpoint management are described as standard UI/API workflows, not conversational control. missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven administration/config of the platform itself, independent hands-on proof of agentic 'operate-by-chat' behavior beyond model prompting.
